﴿Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws,﴾ meaning Satan. It may be a verbal noun (maṣdar) or a noun (ism).

Qatadah said: al-Khannas has a snout like the snout of a dog in the chest of the human being; when the servant remembers his Lord, he withdraws. It is also said: his head is like the head of a snake, placing his head upon the core of the heart, wishing and speaking to it; when Allah is mentioned he withdraws, and when Allah is not mentioned he returns and places his head down again. This is the meaning of: ﴿who whispers in the breasts of mankind﴾, with a hidden speech whose meaning reaches the heart without being heard.
